<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/subscription">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Signup" name="Subscription signup"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Cancellation" name="Cancellation request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Updates" name="Subscription updates, enhancements, or renewal notifications"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Subscription">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Service" name="Subscription service" processRef="Process_Subscription"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Signup" name="Submit signup" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Start_Signup"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Cancellation" name="Submit cancellation request" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Catch_Cancellation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Updates" name="Send subscription updates" sourceRef="Task_SendUpdates" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Subscription" name="Subscription service lifecycle" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Service">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_System" name="System">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Signup</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GenerateAccount</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssignAccess</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_WaitForCycleOrCancellation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Catch_NextCycle</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AutomatedBilling</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendUpdates</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Support" name="Support team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Catch_Cancellation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProcessCancellation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Terms</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ApplyRefund</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ApplyCharge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NoAdjustment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_MergeAdjustments</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Deactivate</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SettleBalance</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_SubscriptionClosed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Signup" name="Customer signs up">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Signup" messageRef="Message_Signup"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GenerateAccount" name="Generate account"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_AssignAccess" name="Assign access"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_WaitForCycleOrCancellation" name="Wait for cycle or cancellation" eventGatewayType="Exclusive"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_NextCycle" name="Next regular cycle">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerEventDefinition_NextCycle"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_AutomatedBilling" name="Run automated billing cycle"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendUpdates" name="Send updates, enhancements, or renewal notifications" messageRef="Message_Updates"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_Cancellation" name="Cancellation request received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Cancellation" messageRef="Message_Cancellation"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProcessCancellation" name="Process cancellation request"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Terms" name="Determine adjustment under terms" default="Flow_NoAdjustment"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApplyRefund" name="Apply refund"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApplyCharge" name="Apply charge"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NoAdjustment" name="Make no adjustment"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeAdjustments" name="Merge adjustment outcomes"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Deactivate" name="Deactivate subscription"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SettleBalance" name="Settle final account balance"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_SubscriptionClosed" name="Subscription closed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Signup_Generate" sourceRef="Start_Signup" targetRef="Task_GenerateAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Generate_Assign" sourceRef="Task_GenerateAccount" targetRef="Task_AssignAccess"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Assign_Wait" sourceRef="Task_AssignAccess" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForCycleOrCancellation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wait_Cycle" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForCycleOrCancellation" targetRef="Catch_NextCycle"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wait_Cancellation" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForCycleOrCancellation" targetRef="Catch_Cancellation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Cycle_Billing" sourceRef="Catch_NextCycle" targetRef="Task_AutomatedBilling"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Billing_Updates" sourceRef="Task_AutomatedBilling" targetRef="Task_SendUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Updates_Wait" sourceRef="Task_SendUpdates" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForCycleOrCancellation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Cancellation_Process" sourceRef="Catch_Cancellation" targetRef="Task_ProcessCancellation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Process_Terms" sourceRef="Task_ProcessCancellation" targetRef="Gateway_Terms"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Terms_Refund" sourceRef="Gateway_Terms" targetRef="Task_ApplyRefund">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">refundApplies</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Terms_Charge" sourceRef="Gateway_Terms" targetRef="Task_ApplyCharge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">chargeApplies</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAdjustment" sourceRef="Gateway_Terms" targetRef="Task_NoAdjustment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Refund_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ApplyRefund" targetRef="Gateway_MergeAdjustments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Charge_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ApplyCharge" targetRef="Gateway_MergeAdjustments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAdjustment_Merge" sourceRef="Task_NoAdjustment" targetRef="Gateway_MergeAdjustments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_Deactivate" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeAdjustments" targetRef="Task_Deactivate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Deactivate_Settle" sourceRef="Task_Deactivate" targetRef="Task_SettleBalance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Settle_End" sourceRef="Task_SettleBalance" targetRef="End_SubscriptionClosed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
